decisions.statement: Where a document sits is read off the pages there rather than spelled here.
A shape is the path of a page that is there with its slug blanked out.
Only the last two parts of a path have the slug.
Only the last two parts of a path are blanked.
Every shape the pages there take is asked.
A reading that will not answer falls back to the shape the pages took last.
A slug is asked as a shell word the terminal expands rather than as a slug now.
A seat bound to a project has no persona document by design.
A persona whose document has not moved in has no document yet.
A seat with no persona document takes on no persona.
A fresh session reseeds no persona document.
Nothing here says which document a seat needs.

definition: whether a persona's or a person's document is there, asked in shell by its slug
